paragraphs.text: Planeswalkers , characters who can travel between the planes of the Multiverse , are central to the Magic storyline .

The following characters are confirmed to be Planeswalkers. This includes Planeswalkers from both before and after the Great Mending , as well as former Planeswalkers and Planeswalkers whose spark is dormant. Following the Desparkening , the status of many Planeswalkers' sparks is unknown.
The following Planeswalkers have not appeared on their own cards, nor have they played a large role in the storyline.
Ā — A tyrant. Killed by Tyler . ( )
The Demonic Leviathan , killed and eaten by Nicol Bolas on Dominaria around -15,000 AR
" Icy ", killed by Garruk on Shandalar.
The creator of the plane that became Phyrexia , a humanoid who took the form of a dragon. Died around -5,000 AR.
Hixus 's mentor (likely ), likely a hieromancer.
The Planeswalker who summoned Sengir from Dominaria to use in a battle in Ulgrotha (dead).
A raving mad, self-styled shark goddess that lived in the deepest part of a maritime plane's planet-spanning ocean. Phased out by Teferi .

Unnamed Planeswalkers last seen on Ravnica during the War of the Spark in 4560 AR (killed in the war unless otherwise mentioned): A large viashino with lime-green skin Two vedalken A tall elven woman A four-armed ogre A short male human with green hair An elderly female human A teenage human A female human Planeswalker with a shaved head and metal-casting powers A tall elven Planeswalker in a long white hooded cloak A dark-haired human Planeswalker wearing a red scarf A blonde-haired human Planeswalker wearing a padded armor vest An older man with turquoise eyes and a carefully trimmed white beard (fate unknown). A woman with jet black hair and glowing green eyes who suggested hiding from the Dreadhorde (fate unknown). An aven who considered surrendering to Bolas (fate unknown).
33 unnamed Planeswalkers appeared in Duels of the Planeswalkers 2013 in 4558 AR.
It is unclear whether the following characters are Planeswalkers:
Nailah , Queen of Rabiah ( ) (Playable as a nonlegendary Creature )
Ravi Sengir 's master, who gave her the Apocalypse Chime (dead)
Thane Du-Moriss IV ( )
The Thorn (Possibly )
Xavis ' intended enemy
The following characters were considered Planeswalkers in stories before Mirage , but this has been contradicted by later information:
The following characters were often confused as Planeswalkers by fans but have been confirmed not to be.
The Elder Dragons (excluding Nicol Bolas and Ugin)
Myojin of Night's Reach
The following characters possessed a Planeswalker's spark, but either lost the spark or died before they could ignite it.
Glacian — Died around -5,000 AR.
Glissa — Transferred the spark to Slobad , compleated .
Radha — Extinguished the spark closing time rifts during the Temporal crisis of Dominaria .
Possibly Zilgeth — Died around 2434 AR .

After the Desparkening , the following characters have all been identified as embers ; potential Planeswalkers. They all had the potential to ignite . It is unknown if this may yet come true under the right conditions.
Comet ( ), the space dog.
Space Beleren ( ), Jace Beleren in un-iverse space.
B.O.B. ( ), the Bevy of Beebles .
Urza ( ), but just his head.
